title: n8n executions older than 14 days vanish and the SQLite file never shrinks
symptoms: Executions list stops at two weeks back
Only the last 10,000 executions are kept
database.sqlite keeps its size after executions are deleted
cause: Pruning is on by default with a 336 hour max age and a 10,000 execution cap. SQLite keeps freed pages for reuse, so the file does not shrink until it is vacuumed.
fix: Raise EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE or EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE_MAX_COUNT if you need longer history, export what you must keep, and enable vacuum on startup for SQLite.
affected: Self-hosted n8n 1.x and 2.x with default settings, as of 2026-10
